title: Vision-Default, Prior-Override: Causal Mechanisms of Perception-Knowledge Conflict in Vision-Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2606.28273v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Vision-language models must reconcile visual evidence with memorized world knowledge when the two conflict. How they resolve this conflict shapes the reliability of multimodal systems, yet prior work characterizes it behaviorally without a component-level causal account. We combine activation patching across three granularities (residual stream, attention heads, and MLP sublayers) with model-component ablation studies and mechanistic analysis. Across three VLM families, we find that visual grounding emerges by default, whereas prior grounding depends on a small set of causally necessary attention heads (2.5-4.8%) concentrated in the second half of the network. These heads enable answers from stored world knowledge (e.g., "red" for a strawberry) despite conflicting visual input. Ablating them flips predictions from knowledge-grounded to visually grounded answers in 68-96% of cases under prior-knowledge prompts, but changes only 0.8-7.

translated_title: 视觉为默认、先验可覆盖：视觉语言模型中感知-知识冲突的因果机制
translated_abstract: 当视觉证据与记忆中的世界知识发生冲突时，视觉语言模型必须对二者进行调和。模型如何解决这种冲突决定了多模态系统的可靠性，然而以往的工作仅从行为层面进行刻画，缺乏组件层面的因果解释。我们将三个粒度（残差流、注意力头和MLP子层）上的激活修补与模型组件消融研究及机制分析相结合。在三个视觉语言模型家族中，我们发现视觉接地是默认涌现的行为，而先验接地则依赖于一小部分因果必需的注意力头（占2.5-4.8%），这些注意力头集中在网络的后半部分。这些注意力头使模型能够在视觉输入相冲突的情况下，依然依据存储的世界知识给出答案（例如，对草莓回答“红色”）。消融这些注意力头后，在先验知识提示下，68-96%的案例中模型预测从基于知识的答案翻转为基于视觉的答案，但仅改变0.8-7（摘要原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 该研究通过多粒度激活修补与组件消融首次从因果机制层面揭示了视觉语言模型的感知-知识冲突：视觉接地是默认行为，而基于先验知识的回答仅依赖于集中于网络后半部分的一小部分（2.5-4.8%）因果必需的注意力头。
en_tdlr: This study provides the first component-level causal account of perception-knowledge conflict in vision-language models via activation patching and ablation, showing that visual grounding is the default behavior while prior-knowledge-based answers rely on a small set (2.5-4.8%) of causally necessary attention heads concentrated in the second half of the network.
